checks.name: Genesis Chain Integrity
checks.description: Verifies a newly created custody record is cryptographically valid and linked to GENESIS

checks.name: Cryptographic Chain Extension
checks.description: Verifies that appending an event correctly links to the previous hash and maintains validity

checks.name: Data Tamper Detection
checks.description: Verifies that any modification to event metadata (e.g. operation) invalidates the cryptographic hash

checks.name: Linkage Tamper Detection
checks.description: Verifies that modifying the previousCustodyHash breaks the chain linkage and is detected

checks.name: Revocation Propagation
checks.description: Verifies that a revocation event correctly updates the record status to REVOKED while maintaining chain integrity

summary: Hard Acceptance Gate 167 PASSED: Chain-of-Custody system verified for cryptographic integrity, tamper detection, and status propagation.
